  • April 13th – Brawks, Gotaga and Squeezie join.[1]
  • April 14th – Snayzy, PodaSai, Nikof, Ketzon and Sylkaos join.[2]
  • January 15th – Sylkaos leaves Manager position.[3]
  • June 13th – Vanyak3kk joins.[4]
  • December 2nd – Snayzy leaves.[5]
  • December 4th – Akiira, xsweeze and Merstach join.[6][7]
  • April 8th – MariusCOW, Pollo and SwizzY join.[8]
  • July 15th – Malibuca and P1ng join.[9]
  • October 14th – PodaSai, SwizzY, xsweeze, Malibuca, P1ng and Ketzon leave.[10][11]
  • November 26th – Nikof changes role from Head of Fortnite to CEO.[12]
  • January 20th – Pollo leaves.[13]
  • March 30th – Kurama joins.[14]
  • June 22nd – Vergo joins.[15]
  • September 22nd – Rax joins.[16]
  • October 7th – Merstach, MariusCOW and Vergo leave.[17]
